title: Request a recorded capture
responsibility: Builds a request for the stored bytes of a capture listed in an evidence result, keeping its exact scenario, state and revision identifiers.

inputs.name: artifactQuery.result
inputs.description: The evidence answer containing the before and after captures, their verification records, and the notes and evidence revisions used for the read.

inputs.name: artifactQuery.scope
inputs.description: The entity, project context, branch, commit and viewing mode to carry into the byte request. The caller must supply the scope that belongs to the result; this function does not check that they match.

inputs.name: artifactQuery.side
inputs.description: Choose before or after to search only the captures listed on that side.

inputs.name: artifactQuery.file
inputs.description: Either the stored filename of a capture or the exact capture object already held in the selected side. Object matching uses the same object, not a copy with equal fields. Only captures with stored media are eligible.

outputs.name: artifactQuery
outputs.description: A request containing the supplied scope and the selected record, scenario, state, evidence identifier, image hash and pinned revisions. A missing viewport becomes null. Returns null if that side has no record or does not list a matching capture with stored media; it does not read the bytes or build a file address.
